summary: Breakpoint week kept Solflare busy on X, but most @solflare chatter was Community Hub points and merch, not packs. A few creators posted about ripping Solflare Packs, with one post getting 69 likes. Courtyard turned 5 with $5,000 in pack giveaways and a livestream, and an on-chain thread says 9 in 10 Courtyard pulls are sold back instantly. On the mainstream side, a post calling Pokémon a "nightmare" of scalpers, fakes and queues got the most likes in our search, and PSA wait times came up again.

top_posts.text: Getting into pokemon cards is a nightmare, it's just scalpers and fake cards and queues left and right, I just want the pretty art man
top_posts.why_it_matters: Most-liked pain-point post of the day: a new collector put off by scalpers, fakes and queues. This is the mainstream buyer we want, and the problem packs with real graded cards can solve.

sources_note: Built from 14 X recent-search queries (start 2026-11-16 10:05 CET) plus timeline reads for @Collector_Crypt, @Courtyard_io and @phygitals, via the x connector. Engagement and follower counts are from the X API at about 10:05 CET on 17 Nov. Most @solflare results were Community Hub points/merch posts and are only partly included. Giveaway, spam, token-shill and off-topic hits were skipped. The 'Post. Earn. Lock In' mention and @rana_eth47a are general Solflare posts, not packs-specific. No @phygitals posts in the window. New creators were checked against /workspace/collector-base/collector-base.csv.
